estimator.name: nsight_pp0_first_alloc_extend_marker

start.selection: For each request at logged FCFS ordinal r, select rank-0 alloc_extend marker ordinal 2*r, which starts the request's first 32768-token chunk.

excluded_intervals: Client-side and pre-server wait before SGLang receives the request.
SGLang internal queue time from queue admission through scheduler dequeue.
CPU time from scheduler dequeue/forward_entry to the first rank-0 GPU marker.
estimator.token_ready_end: SGLang request_finished_ts; every measured request generated exactly one token.
estimator.mapping_rule: For FCFS ordinal r, use rank-0 alloc_extend marker ordinal 2*r; marker 2*r+1 is the request's second 32768-token chunk.
estimator.queue_exclusion: Client/pre-server wait and SGLang's internal wait queue are excluded.

bias_and_uncertainty.direction: The GPU marker occurs after unrecorded CPU forward_entry, so this marker-defined service interval slightly underestimates CPU-dequeue-to-token service TTFT.
bias_and_uncertainty.interpretation: The approximately 32 ms median and 42 ms P99 are an observed scale, not a hard error bound, because the preceding PP0 result log is not the missing forward_entry timestamp.

primary.definition: Client eof_epoch_ns lies inside the report's inclusive stable scheduler window; this selects source FCFS ordinals 1 through 267.

full_run.definition: All 300 successful measured requests in logged FCFS order, including pipeline startup and drain.

request_mapping.note: Synthetic request 0084 arrived at FCFS ordinal 48, shifting ordinals 48 through 84; mapping uses logged FCFS order rather than the numeric suffix.
